notes.title: Introducing - DeathOmen
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aaMqcjBqvxM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello my friends,
Jeff Winner here,
I'm very happy to announce my newest game, DeathOmen.

I started this game as soon as I released Horror Story: hallowseed
But no, this game is not linked to the events of the previous game, nor the Horror Story franchise.

Because it is a different game, which is not tied to a story, but to a journey, in which you are the main character.

That's right, you won't control a Michael, or an Anna.

You choose your character's name and dry the 7 night journey in a house full of mysteries, which you should remember,

because it's your childhood home, but you've forgotten everything, and for some reason you're back in that home.

But that's where you'll start to find out.
1 - Because you left the house at such a young age.
2 - because he decided to forget.
3 - What happened to the people who were there before you.

You will have to overcome these 7 nights to reach the end, and in the middle of the way of course... you will be very scared.
